chapter: Technique and life on the road (repeated passages)
title: Bandleaders' faults and musicians' faults
summary: Asked about leaders, he declines to name anyone but says both leaders and musicians can be aggravating.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: I guess you've found yourself in so many different situations playing over the years, maybe you've formed some opinion of leaders and some of the things they do right and some of the things they do wrong...
Would you care to talk about that a little? You don't have to mention any specific people if you don't care to.
I wouldn't mention nobody. But it's true, they do do some things that really are aggravating at times, you know. I guess so does the musician, too. You know, it works both ways.
